title: Flow Graph to Video Grounding for Weakly-Supervised Multi-step Localization

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding

evidence.quote: To this end, we introduce the new problem of flow graph to video grounding.

background_setup.summary: Understanding video content from procedural activities has recently seen a surge in interest with various applications including future anticipation , procedure planning , question answering and multi-step localization .

evidence.quote: Understanding video content from procedural activities has recently seen a surge in interest with various applications including future anticipation [34,13], procedure planning [5,1], question answering [43] and multi-step localization [45,38,24,23,10].

background_setup.summary: In this work, we tackle multi-step localization, i.e., inferring the temporal location of procedure steps present in the video.

evidence.quote: In this work, we tackle multi-step localization, i.e., inferring the temporal location of procedure steps present in the video.

prior_work_summary.summary: We propose a new graph-to-sequence grounding algorithm (i.e., Graph2Vid) and show that Graph2Vid outperforms baseline approaches in step localization performance and efficiency.

evidence.quote: We propose a new graph-to-sequence grounding algorithm (i.e., Graph2Vid) and show that Graph2Vid outperforms baseline approaches in step localization performance and efficiency.
